commit_subject: (screen-flagged) b1.6 (PR #1300): removes hard-coded exemplar entry_is_line_a..e derived rules (proof atoms citing other chapters' HTS lines) from every generated chapter and makes them caller inputs; summary claims runtime semantics unchanged — unsure, part of the same decoupling repair.
description: The identifiers entry_is_line_a, entry_is_line_b, entry_is_line_c, entry_is_line_d, and entry_is_line_e are caller inputs supplied by entry preparation from incidence classification.

triage.pre_fix_wrong_because: Chapter 75's authority-membership predicates were encoded as identity with five exemplar HTS lines from other chapters, so the chapter's section 301 / section 232 / section 201 / reciprocal-exclusion gates could never fire for any chapter 75 nickel line the cited Chapter 99 notes actually list.
triage.triage_notes: Same pattern as index 72; diff identical up to chapter prefix, parenthesis count and YAML key spelling. No exemplar line belongs to chapter 75. Same doubt as index 72.
triage.verifier_justification: The pre-fix ch75 module defined its authority-membership predicates as identity against five HTS lines from other chapters (7202.11.10.00 ferroalloy, 7601.10.30.00 aluminum, 9506.62.40.40 footballs, 2203.00.00.30 beer, 8541.42.00.10 PV cells), each carrying proof atoms citing those other chapters' provisions, and the chapter's own gates consumed them directly (`entry_is_reciprocal_annex_excluded` formula is literally `entry_is_line_a`; the §301 component is a five-slot sum over `entry_is_line_a..e`), so for any chapter 75 nickel line every such gate was statically dead. Reading the cited Chapter 99 notes through the pinned release (us-rulespec-2026-08-08-obbb-alien-snap, corpus commit e79781bd) shows the source disagrees in both directions: the 9903.01.32 annex exclusion list announced at chapter-99 page-178 continues onto page-184, which lists 7501.10.00, 7502.10.00, 7502.20.00, 7503.00.00, 7504.00.00 and 7508.90.50 (so the exclusion should fire for nickel lines and never could), and the 9903.88.03 List 3 enumeration announced at page-264 runs through page-283, which lists 28 chapter 75 subheadings (7501.10 through 7507.12 and more) at the 25% action that the module could never apply. The fix deletes those five ungrounded identity conditions and their foreign-chapter proof atoms, making membership caller-supplied — exactly the "condition with no basis in the cited source / formula grounded on the wrong provision, removed or re-grounded" shape, not a mechanical or bookkeeping change (five rule formulas, their proof atoms, and the module's input surface all change).
triage.verifier_notes: Refutation attempts that failed: (1) "mechanical" is excluded because the diff removes five derived rules with formulas and proof atoms and converts them to inputs, so inputs/outputs and runtime values for chapter-75 entries change; (2) "not_a_defect / new coverage never claimed" is excluded because the consuming rules advertise chapter-99 grounding in their own `source` and proof atoms (`source: Chapter 99 U.S. note reciprocal annex exclusion list under heading 9903.01.32`, atoms citing chapter-99 page-177/page-182 and page-273) while implementing the predicate as a foreign-chapter line identity, and the PR body itself calls the prior coupling one that "unlawfully suppressed the surcharge on §301-member lines for all origins". Competing kind worth a reviewer's eye: wrong_entity_or_scope (the predicate ranged over the wrong HTS line population); I kept untraceable_branch because the kind definition explicitly covers "formulas grounded on the wrong provision" and the fix's operative act is removal, not re-scoping. Caveats: this commit only removes the definitions — the membership-semantic re-gating (`entry_is_section_122_exempt` / `entry_is_section_232_covered`) and the §232 steel component described in PR #1300 are not in this module's diff at this SHA, where the §301 component still reads `if entry_is_line_a and origin_is_china: list_1_additional_ad_valorem_rate ...`; and the module summary's retained boilerplate "changes no formula tokens, dates, inputs, proof atoms, or runtime values" is false for this commit (it removes proof atoms and adds five input slots), which is why the screener flagged it. The maintainer's later PR comment notes flags c and e were subsequently "fully replaced and no longer valid input slots", so the final merged state differs from this commit.
